title: n8n vs Zapier vs Make
summary: n8n vs Zapier vs Make: which one should you actually use? An honest take from someone who builds automations for work.
body: n8n vs Zapier vs Make: which one should you actually use? An honest take from someone who builds automations for work.

Zapier: best if you just want it to work. Make: best for visual, multi-step flows. n8n: best for builders and AI workflows (what I use).
Pick by who maintains it. And the tool matters less than the process: map the task on paper, automate one small part, switch tools later if needed.

Zapier: https://zapier.com
Make: https://www.make.com
n8n: https://n8n.io

Which do you use? Tell me in the comments and why.
